definitions.gloss: medical treatment; therapy; procedure (especially hands-on therapies)
definitions.explanation: A treatment or therapeutic procedure, often referring to massage, acupuncture, chiropractic care, or cosmetic procedures rather than major surgery.

examples.japanese: {施術|せじゅつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
{施術|せじゅつ}⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{約|やく}→約：09563_yaku⟧⟦{一|いち}{時間|じかん}→一時間：00941_ichijikan⟧です。
examples.english: The treatment time is about one hour.

examples.japanese: ⟦{経験|けいけん}{豊富|ほうふ}→経験豊富：19017_keikenhoufu⟧な{施術者|せじゅつしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{丁寧|ていねい}→丁寧：00896_teinei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦マッサージ→マッサージ：00272_massaaji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦くれた→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: An experienced practitioner gave me a careful massage.

notes:
Commonly used in the context of massage therapy, acupuncture, chiropractic care, beauty treatments, and other hands-on therapeutic practices. Less formal than ⟦{手術|しゅじゅつ}→手術：03218_shujutsu⟧ (surgery), which refers to invasive surgical procedures.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {施術|せじゅつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧: to receive treatment
- {施術|せじゅつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧: to perform a treatment
- {施術者|せじゅつしゃ}: practitioner, therapist
- {施術|せじゅつ}⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧: treatment time
- {施術|せじゅつ}⟦{後|ご}→後：30157_go⟧: after treatment

PRONUNCIATION:
Also read as {施術|しじゅつ}, though せじゅつ is more common in modern usage, especially in healthcare and beauty contexts.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{手術|しゅじゅつ}→手術：03218_shujutsu⟧: surgery — invasive surgical procedures performed by doctors
- ⟦{治療|ちりょう}→治療：03503_chiryou⟧: medical treatment — broader term covering all types of medical care
- ⟦{処置|しょち}→処置：05823_shochi⟧: treatment, procedure — often emergency or routine medical measures
